weather.summary: Early October in Columbia averages an 80°F afternoon high and a 63°F morning low. Ten-year observed range for these dates: 68°F to 97°F highs, 48°F to 77°F lows. Measurable rain on about 1 day in 5, but the shoulder-season swings are real.
weather.details: This is a two-wardrobe weekend. Mornings at the first game are genuinely cool — bring a jacket. Afternoons can still reach the mid-90s, so bring the full heat kit as well: water, electrolytes, sunscreen, cooling towels. Rain is unlikely on any single day, though not impossible. Start hydrating the day before travel. Recomputed September 18, 2026 from ten years of recorded daily observations for Columbia, SC (2016–2025, Open-Meteo historical archive). A reliable daily forecast becomes available around September 28–30.

updates.title: Hotel availability re-checked live — new list
updates.description: We re-ran availability for October 2–4, two adults and one child, and published a fresh list. Country Inn & Suites at Harbison is confirmed at $161 per night and is now our top pick. The Hampton Inn Harbison did not come back as available in any search, so we have stopped recommending it. Rates come from a live search scoped to those exact dates and are a partial result set — a hotel missing from the list is unknown rather than sold out. Confirm the current price before booking.

updates.title: Brackets are posted — our divisions are confirmed
updates.description: SCUFC published bracket placements on September 16 and we have now verified them at the source. Our four teams landed in four different divisions: U9 Premier is in Under 09 Boys Red (5 teams), U9 Blue in Under 09 Boys Green (8 teams), U10 Premier in Under 10 Boys Red (6 teams), and U10 Blue in Under 10 Boys Green (8 teams). Nobody in the same division — which means no cross-team matchups that weekend. Opponents are known now; game times, fields and the actual pairings post with the full schedule on September 24.

updates.title: No stay-to-play policy published — re-checked September 18
updates.description: We checked the official tournament page, the SCUFC host site and the registration portal again on September 18, 2026 and still found no housing requirement or approved-hotel list for the Carolina Cup. Our picks are simply the closest options with confirmed availability — there is no housing portal to book through. We have asked tournament director Tripp Miller to confirm.

updates.title: Online check-in is open — complete it now
updates.description: The accepted team list posted September 14 and all four of our teams are on it. SCUFC's tournament page states that online check-in opened after that, that there is NO on-site check-in, and that teams should start online check-in immediately. This is the one item that cannot be handled at the field. Re-verified September 18, 2026.

updates.title: Game schedule posts September 24 — re-checked September 18
updates.description: Brackets are done; the full schedule is the last piece. It posts September 24, 2026 with game times, fields and the actual pairings. Until then we do not know which of SCUFC's five complexes our teams play at. This app updates itself the moment the schedule lands, and we will send the updated guide with a departure time for every family.

updates.title: 2026 rules document still not published — re-checked September 18
updates.description: We checked the official tournament content pages again on September 18, 2026 and found no 2026 Carolina Cup rules document. Game length, mercy rule, substitutions and the tiebreaker order all remain unconfirmed. We will not fill these in from another tournament's rulebook. Rules questions can go to Tournament Director Tripp Miller at tripp@scufc.com.
